title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Claims Desk Card: Deadlines, Documents and Loss Conditions
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver Claims Desk Card — Deadlines, Documents and Loss Conditions

Every level of the Kestrel GAP Waiver — Essential, Standard, Plus, Premier, Premier Plus and Max — uses the same claim deadlines, the same document list and the same loss conditions.

## Deadlines (calendar days unless stated)

| Item | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim must be filed within, after the loss date (loss date is day 0) | 90 days | 90 days | 90 days | 90 days | 90 days | 90 days |
| Every required document must arrive within, after filing | 120 days | 120 days | 120 days | 120 days | 120 days | 120 days |
| Days after a theft before an unrecovered vehicle is treated as a loss | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days |
| Days after a denial within which new documents can reopen the decision | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days |

## Documents

Required for every claim, at every level:

- the insurer settlement letter;
- the total loss valuation;
- proof of the insurance deductible.

A theft claim also requires a police report, at every level.

| Document rule | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Police report required for a theft claim | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Proof of the primary deductible required to add deductible coverage | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Insurer letter must state the actual cash value and the deductions | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Loss conditions

| Condition | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Physical damage insurance must have been in force at the loss date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Losses on vehicles in commercial use excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Loss dated before the waiver sale date denied | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Counting the days (hypothetical dates)

- Filing window: with the loss date as day 0, a loss on 1 June leaves day 90 — 30 August — as the last day within the 90 days; 31 August is day 91.
- Theft: a vehicle stolen on 1 June is treated as a loss only if it has not been recovered within the 30 days after the theft, a period that runs to 1 July.
- Reconsideration: after a denial dated 10 October, a document received on 9 November is the 30th day after the denial.
